body:
Stacked Phase 22 hardening slice on PR #717.

Exact base:
work/metaengine-rsi-anchored-verifier-shadow-lifecycle-v1 @ 3934772774bc082739c2e578777f7668640c524e

Exact head:
work/metaengine-rsi-verifier-shadow-durable-v1 @ 49aa4e6c6730513f617351c0be531b7a13845f5e

Fixes two evidence-integrity defects in the verifier-shadow archive:
- durable-before-memory: a new archive row is now persisted from a preview row-set and only becomes visible in-memory after fsync + rename succeeds;
- restart/add replay now independently re-validates zero-authority policy fields, exact derived regression/improvement/blocker state, candidate/incumbent/root separation, specialty tags, archive eligibility, archive identity digest, and review/evaluation bindings instead of trusting a self-rehashed row.

Regression coverage:
- self-rehashed evaluation cannot expose held-out anchors;
- self-rehashed review cannot grant verifier activation semantics;
- failed durable write leaves row_count=0 / eligible_count=0;
- restart rejects a persisted self-rehashed policy downgrade even when row/state hashes are recomputed.

No active verifier replacement, Browser effect, scheduler, promotion, install, self-update, canary or production mutation authority is added.

RSI V1.31 convergence.

work/metaengine-rsi-regression-replay-v1 @ fef38885f8c1504c3a5f459279a61e01d4d94fd6

Exact skill source:
work/metaengine-rsi-contrastive-reliability-v1 @ 835a31eb36efb76b392f264b92b536da4a14c9a9

The RSI roadmap had two green but diverged source lines after V1.24. This PR forward-ports only the skill-specific modules/tests/research docs onto the latest frontier/capability-retention head, then semantically unions the immutable trust roots.

Converged mechanisms:
- verified typed skill library with strict interface compatibility and bounded DAG composition;
- two-timescale meta-skill evolution;
- behaviorally validated scope expansion;
- trajectory-contrastive skill reliability;
- current disagreement / experience graph / benchmark provenance / frontier co-evolution / regression replay line remains intact.

All four skill policy modules are added to Candidate Builder, Tournament and Promotion immutable trust roots.

No Browser effect, production deployment, scheduler, signing, promotion or self-update authority.
